title: Homepage Hero Banner Image Dimensions and Design Guidelines

sections.heading: Hero Banner Dimensions
sections.content:
The recommended image dimensions for the homepage hero background banner are 1920 pixels wide by 600 pixels high (1920x600 px). Use optimized JPEG or WebP images under 300KB to ensure fast page load speeds on mobile and desktop.
To update:
1. Navigate to Settings > Design Settings.
2. Click the 'Homepage' tab.
3. Under Hero Background Image, click 'Choose File' or upload from Media Manager.
4. Adjust the background overlay color opacity if needed.
5. Click 'Save Changes'.

full_text:
Hero Banner Dimensions
The recommended image dimensions for the homepage hero background banner are 1920 pixels wide by 600 pixels high (1920x600 px). Use optimized JPEG or WebP images under 300KB to ensure fast page load speeds on mobile and desktop.
To update:
1. Navigate to Settings > Design Settings.
2. Click the 'Homepage' tab.
3. Under Hero Background Image, click 'Choose File' or upload from Media Manager.
4. Adjust the background overlay color opacity if needed.
5. Click 'Save Changes'.
